$description: The icon set of the VLC Redesign (design-1.0): every icon the desktop app ships, copied from modules/gui/qt/pixmaps/redesign by design/tools/sync_assets.py.
license: CC BY 4.0, derived from "VLC Redesign (Community)" by Juxtopposed

glyphs.description: The icons of the Figma "Icon" component set (42:356), exported as PNG, one folder per icon, one file per state. 24 x 24 unless noted; @2x files are the same state at twice the size.

svg.description: Single-colour SVG icons of the top bar, the sidebar and the player (24 x 24 unless noted).

duo.description: Two-tone menu icons. Placeholder colours (ColorizedSvgIcon): #FF00FF = outline (Dark/FG/A2 #8F8F8F, light #2E2E2E), #FF8800 = details (Accent Dim), #00FFFF = the full accent.

widgets.description: Chevrons and checks of the classic (widget) dialogs, one file per theme and state.

player.description: Raster player and window-frame pieces (corners per theme).

images.description: Other raster pieces: onboarding theme previews, track icons, volume states, list/grid toggles.

states.active: active or hovered, #D37918 (the default accent; the app tints it with the chosen one)
